Name: Pokemon Eggventure - Junimo
Author: Parme69
Description:
[center]Bring a Pokémon touch to the Community Center by replacing the adorable [b]Junimos[/b] with equally adorable [b]Pichu[/b]!

[/center]
[center]This mod transforms the appearance of every Junimo into Pichu while preserving all of their original animations and behavior. Whether they're restoring the Community Center or helping on your farm, your little forest spirits will now look like everyone's favorite baby Electric-type Pokémon.

[/center]
[center]The mod only changes the visuals and does not affect gameplay.


[img]https://i.postimg.cc/0ryTJqxk/features.png[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
[center]Replaces all Junimos with Pichu.[/center]
[center]Preserves the original animations and behavior[/center]
[center]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6[/center]
[center]No gameplay changes[/center]
[center]Lightweight and easy to install

[/center]
[center]This mod is part of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49098][b]Pokémon Eggventure[/b] project[/url], but it can also be used as a standalone visual enhancement.[/center]
